auth.loginSubtitle: Log in to execute protected hardware commands
auth.setupSubtitle: Create administrator credentials to protect write operations
auth.barrierDesc: Stage T1 telemetry queries remain available to all users. Diagnostic self-tests, persistent parameter modifications, and live power cuts require authenticated credentials.
auth.passwordMinLength: Password must be at least 8 characters long
auth.authenticatedDesc: Session active for {{username}}. Diagnostic self-tests, persistent parameter modifications, and live power cuts are unlocked.
auth.protectedDesc: Stage T1 telemetry queries remain available to all users. Diagnostic self-tests, persistent parameter modifications, and live power cuts require authenticated credentials.
auth.setupRequiredDesc: No administrator credentials configured. Set up credentials to unlock control commands.

safetyGate.title: Firmware Safety Gate
safetyGate.desc: To prevent firmware corruption or accidental load drop, commands are strictly categorized by risk. Each stage unlocks sequentially.
safetyGate.noDeviceError: Error: No active UPS device selected

stageT2.title: Stage T2: Non-Destructive Actions
stageT2.desc: Diagnostic actions that do not alter flash/EEPROM or drop live load power.
stageT2.buzzerDesc: Saves the UPS audible-alarm setting (PEA / PDA). This is a persistent setting and requires Stage T3.
stageT2.buzzerNeedsT3: Unlock Stage T3 to change this setting.
stageT2.test10sDesc: Discharges battery for 10 seconds under load to verify battery health.
stageT2.cancelTestDesc: Immediately terminates any ongoing battery discharge test.

stageT4.title: Stage T4: Live Power Control
stageT4.desc: Commands that can cut load output or trigger hardware shutdown.
stageT4.shutdownDesc: Shuts down UPS output after a 0.3m (~18 seconds) delay.
stageT4.shutdownWarn: Are you sure? Connected equipment will lose power!
stageT4.cancelShutdownDesc: Cancels any active shutdown countdown timer immediately.

flags.title: Device Features & Capabilities
flags.desc: Hardware capabilities supported by your connected UPS.

power.hostWarningDesc: If this computer is connected to this UPS, shutting down or cutting output power will abruptly terminate this machine and cause unsaved data loss.
power.shutdownActiveDesc: UPS output will be cut in:
power.delayedShutdownDesc: Signals the UPS to cut inverter output after a specified delay.
power.confirmShutdownDesc: The UPS will shut down AC output after {{delay}} minute(s). Connected equipment will lose power.
power.shutdownRestoreDesc: Shuts down output after delay, then automatically powers on once AC line returns and restore delay elapses.
power.restoreNote: Notice: Auto-restart requires utility AC power to return. A fully off UPS without mains AC cannot be powered on remotely.
power.confirmRestoreDesc: The UPS will shut down in {{delay}} minute(s). Output will automatically restore {{restore}} minute(s) after AC power is restored.
power.inverterOutputDesc: Turns inverter output ON or OFF directly without powering off internal monitoring microcontrollers.
power.confirmOutputOffDesc: This will immediately cut AC power to all connected equipment.
power.outletsDesc: Independently switch outlet banks 1 and 2 (load shedding or peripheral power management).
power.confirmOutletOffDesc: Equipment plugged into Outlet Group {{group}} will lose power immediately.
